input.summary: Add express performance/conformance warranty with 90-day period and re-performance, repair/replacement or refund remedy
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 5 contains no express warranty that the Services or Works will conform to the Specifications and no remedy for non-conforming work, so we have added our standard 90-day conformance warranty with re-performance, repair/replacement or refund. We can accept a 30-day period for Services as a fallback if needed.

ops.text: Contractor represents and warrants to Company that (i) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (ii) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, each Work (including any software deliverable) will conform in all material respects to the applicable Specifications and documentation; and (iii) the Works will not contain any virus, malicious code or other disabling device. Company's remedy for breach of this warranty is, at Contractor's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming Work, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services or Work. The disclaimer in Paragraph 5(e) does not limit the express warranties set forth in this Paragraph 5.
